lines.text: If you had *ZA WARUDO,* you could *stop time.*
At first, DIO only gets *five seconds.*
Bullets, rain, even his knives. *Everything* freezes.
Nobody else can see what happens inside it.
After drinking Joseph's blood, he reaches *nine seconds.*
Enough time to drop a *road roller* on Jotaro.
But one person can still move in stopped time.
Star Platinum is the *same type* of Stand.
